```{r}
metadata<-read_q2metadata("../artifacts/metadata.tsv")
row.names(metadata)<- metadata$SampleID

feature_table <-read_qza("../artifacts/table.qza")$data
taxonomy_annot <- read_qza('../artifacts/taxonomy_classification/taxonomy.qza')$data

# raw_counts <- taxonomy_annot %>% select("Feature.ID","Confidence","Taxon") %>%

taxonomy_annot <-taxonomy_annot %>% mutate(taxa = str_remove_all(Taxon, "D_\\d__")) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(taxa, "; ", names = c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"),too_few = "align_start") %>%
   mutate_at(c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"), list(~ substr(., 4, nchar(.))))

row.names(taxonomy_annot)<- taxonomy_annot$Feature.ID

feature_table <- as.matrix(feature_table)

sample_names_correct <- colnames(feature_table)
metadata <- metadata[match(sample_names_correct, rownames(metadata)), ]
metadata <- metadata %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID_temp") %>%
  filter(SampleID_temp %in% sample_names_correct) %>%
  arrange(match(SampleID_temp, sample_names_correct)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("SampleID_temp")

if (!all(rownames(metadata) %in% metadata$SampleID)) {
  warning("Some rownames in metadata do not match the SampleID column!")
}

metadata["subject_id"] = metadata['subject-id']
```


```{r}

aggregate_features <- function(feature_table, taxonomy_annot, rank = 'Genus') {
  cat("Aggregating features by", rank, "level...\n")
  
  taxa_meta <- taxonomy_annot %>% select(c(Feature.ID, all_of(rank)))
  
  feature_table_agg <- as.data.frame(feature_table) %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = "Feature.ID") %>%
    merge(taxa_meta, by = "Feature.ID", all.x = TRUE) %>% 
    select(-'Feature.ID') %>%
    mutate(across(!starts_with(rank), as.numeric)) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(rank))) %>% 
    summarize(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    as.data.frame()
  
  rank_val <- feature_table_agg[, rank]
  row.names(feature_table_agg) <- replace(rank_val, is.na(rank_val), 'unknown')
  feature_table_agg <- feature_table_agg[, -1]
  feature_table_agg <- as.matrix(feature_table_agg)
  
  return(feature_table_agg)
}

filter_features <- function(feature_table,metadata, threshold=0.3){
    baselines <- c("v2","v6")
    treatments <- c("v7","v8")
    BL_samples <- metadata%>% filter(visit %in% baselines) %>% pull(SampleID)
    TR_samples <- metadata%>% filter(visit %in% treatments) %>% pull(SampleID)
   
    BL_prv <- rowMeans(feature_table[,BL_samples] >=1, na.rm = T)
    TR_prv <- rowMeans(feature_table[,TR_samples] >=1, na.rm = T)
    
    prevalence_df <- data.frame(
        feature_ids = names(BL_prv),
        prevalence_BL = BL_prv,
        prevalence_TR = TR_prv
      ) %>%
        filter(prevalence_BL >= 0.30 | prevalence_TR>= 0.30)
    
    return(prevalence_df$feature_ids)

}

## Run differential abundant taxa on aggregated data ----
run_dab_aggregated <- function(feature_table_agg, metadata) {
  cat("Running LinDA analysis on aggregated data...\n")
  
  # remove low abundant features
  
  keep_fearures = filter_features(feature_table_agg,metadata,threshold = 0.3)
  filter_features_agg <- feature_table_agg[keep_fearures,]
  
  results <- linda(
    filter_features_agg,  # Matrix: taxa rows, samples columns
    meta = metadata,              # Data.frame: samples rows, with covariates
    formula = "~ visit + (1 | subject_id)",  # Fixed: visit; Random: subject_id for non-independence
    alpha = 0.05,                 # Significance threshold (default 0.05)
    prev.cut = 0,               # has been already filtered, so no more!
    lib.cut = 1,               # no samples removal
    winsor.quan = 0.97,            # Winsorize at 97th percentile for outliers
    n.cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1
  )
  
  return(results)
}

get_sigcombined <- function(linda_results,LFC=1){
  v6 <- linda_results$output$visitv6
  v6_sig <- v6 %>% filter(reject==T, abs(log2FoldChange)>=LFC) %>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column("taxa")

  v7 <- linda_results$output$visitv7
  v7_sig <- v7 %>% filter(reject==T, abs(log2FoldChange)>=LFC) %>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column("taxa")

  v8 <- linda_results$output$visitv8
  v8_sig <- v8 %>% filter(reject==T, abs(log2FoldChange)>=LFC)%>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column("taxa")
  
  combined_sig <- bind_rows(
    v6_sig %>% mutate(visit = "v6"),
    v7_sig %>% mutate(visit = "v7"),
    v8_sig %>% mutate(visit = "v8")
  ) %>% relocate(visit, .before = 1)
  
  return(combined_sig)
}

```

```{r}

linda_results <- run_dab_aggregated(feature_table,metadata)
combined_sig <- get_sigcombined(linda_results,1)
combined_sig <- combined_sig %>% 
    merge(taxonomy_annot, by.x='taxa',by.y = 'Feature.ID')

write_csv(combined_sig,'../export/linDA_ASVs_Sig_LFC1.csv')

ranks <- ranks <- c("Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus")
  for (rank in ranks) {
    print(rank)
    ft_agg <- aggregate_features(feature_table,taxonomy_annot,rank)
    linda_results<-run_dab_aggregated(ft_agg,metadata)
    combined_sig <- get_sigcombined(linda_results,1)
    write_csv(combined_sig,paste0('../export/linDA_',rank,'_Sig_LFC1.csv'))

  }

```
